name: Can you paint directly over bare concrete or cinder block basement walls?

mainEntity.name: Can you paint directly over bare concrete or cinder block basement walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting bare concrete basement walls requires specialized preparation and masonry coatings. Raw concrete, brick, or cinder block tends to draw moisture from surrounding soil, which can cause standard latex paint to bubble, peel, or trap efflorescence. The surface must first be fully cleaned, dry, and sealed with a breathable masonry or waterproofing primer. Acrylic masonry paint or elastomeric coatings are then applied to accommodate slight temperature shifts. Standard drywall paint should never be applied directly onto bare foundation walls without a dedicated masonry base.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, bare concrete walls require deep cleaning, drying, and a dedicated masonry primer or waterproofing sealer before applying acrylic masonry paint. Standard latex paint will peel.
